title: Your New House Has a $14,000 Hidden Bill in Year One
hook: The mortgage payment is the smallest expense you'll face — and that hidden year-one bill will blindside most first-time buyers.
angle: Homebuyer content obsesses over down payments and mortgage rates. Nobody shows the full year-one cost stack that makes buyers go broke fast.
audience: First-time homebuyers, renters considering buying, anyone who bought in the last 1-2 years
key_numbers: 77% of first-year homeowners face an unexpected repair bill
Maintenance rule: 1–3% of home value per year ($12K on a $400K house)
True all-in monthly cost: $3,500 vs $2,100 mortgage on a $400K home
